name: @retroplug/devtest
description: Test node types a device image's check runs: a deterministic source, a digest and a coupled pair, and a script pack's transpose, nest and builtin loop. No product that ships lists it. The script pack's heapBytes is the desktop device-mode tests' figure, which feed it the planner's 256-place queues; behind a device's 64-place MIDI queue the toolchain's check passes it at 42840, so an image that registers it should give it about 45056 of its own.
